title: Expired active reservations are counted as active UI capacity
description: Evidence: CLI reservation rows expose expired separately from status, but dashboard summary counts activeReservations by status === active and TUI repo-store maps every active reservation to expired:false. Impact: console/TUI active-agent and capacity counts can overstate live ownership when a lease is expired but not repaired to status expired.
acceptanceCriteria: UI summaries exclude expired-active reservations from active counts and expose expired-active separately.
Console/TUI coverage includes status: active, expired: true and/or expired expiresAt records.
